Support

Read the documentation and create a small synthetic example before requesting help.

  • Documentation: https://el-cordero.github.io/potentiomap/
  • Issues: https://github.com/el-cordero/potentiomap/issues
  • CRAN: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=potentiomap

Bug reports should include the package and R versions, operating system, input class, CRS, head unit, vertical datum when known, function call, complete warning or error, synthetic reproducer, and sessionInfo().

Do not post confidential well coordinates, client data, private site identifiers, or restricted environmental data in a public issue.

Developed by Elvin Cordero.
